text:
Yes. Your financial data is yours, so you can take it with you. You can export your transactions as CSV, which opens in Excel, Google Sheets, or Numbers, or as JSON, which is useful if you want to use your data in other apps or tools.

Exports are fast. Even with 10,000 transactions, the export finishes in under 2 minutes.

Exporting is also included on the free plan, so you don't have to upgrade to get at your own records. That covers switching budgeting tools, backing up your history, or going through your spending in a spreadsheet.
